background: A group of friends is gathered together, and the conversation turns to the topic of poker, a game the men have been playing without the women. This sparks a lively discussion about gender roles and the perceived exclusivity of certain activities. The women express their curiosity and challenge the notion that poker is a 'guy thing,' questioning why they have never been invited to join the game. The men, caught off guard, attempt to justify the situation by pointing out that they simply don't know any women who play poker.
description: The group decides to have a conversation about gender stereotypes and the inclusion of women in traditionally male activities. This leads to a discussion about how to make their social activities more inclusive.
